integrity: A mathematical proof for all stated cases is supplied. Originality compared with identified direct predecessors; priority risk remains from imperfect transcription and unlocated literature. No independent external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only p>=5 and unit a; excludes p=3, nonunit parameters and higher residue-degree Galois rings. Full-text 1991 transcription has some imperfect equations. Finite enumerations corroborate, not certify, the proof.
